FN-EJL8Z22-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 123
Committee: Agriculture, Conservation and Forestry Sponsor: Senator David Sessions
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 01/21/2026
Senate Bill 123 as introduced would, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, decrease sales tax receipts
to the Education Trust Fund by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of gross
receipts derived from the sale of certain retail fish or other seafood sales, exempted pursuant to
the provisions of this bill.
This bill would also decrease sales tax receipts to county and municipal
governments, that opt via resolution or local ordinance, to authorize the exemption provided by
this bill, by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of gross receipts derived
from the sale of certain retail fish or other seafood and the applicable local tax rate.
